legend: Filya just learned new geometry object — rectangle. He is given a field consisting of n × n unit cells. Rows are numbered from bottom to top with integer from 1 to n. Columns are numbered from left to right with integers from 1 to n. Cell, located at the intersection of the row r and column c is denoted as (r, c). Filya has painted two rectangles, such that their sides are parallel to coordinate axes and each cell lies fully inside or fully outside each of them. Moreover, no cell lies in both rectangles.

Later, hedgehog Filya became interested in the location of his rectangles but was unable to find the sheet of paper they were painted on. They were taken by Sonya and now she wants to play a little game with Filya. He tells her a query rectangle and she replies with the number of initial rectangles that lie fully inside the given query rectangle. The query rectangle should match the same conditions as initial rectangles. Rectangle lies fully inside the query if each o its cells lies inside the query.
Filya knows Sonya really well, so is sure that if he asks more than 200 questions she will stop to reply.
input: The first line of the input contains an integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 216) — size of the field.
For each query an integer between 0 and 2 is returned — the number of initial rectangles that lie fully inside the query rectangle.
output: To make a query you have to print "? x1 y1 x2 y2" (without quotes) (1 ≤ x1 ≤ x2 ≤ n, 1 ≤ y1 ≤ y2 ≤ n), where (x1, y1) stands for the position of the bottom left cell of the query and (x2, y2) stands for the up right cell of the query. You are allowed to ask no more than 200 queries. After each query you should perform "flush" operation and read the answer.

In case you suppose you've already determined the location of two rectangles (or run out of queries) you should print "! x11 y11 x12 y12 x21 y21 x22 y22" (without quotes), where first four integers describe the bottom left and up right cells of the first rectangle, and following four describe the corresponding cells of the second rectangle. You can print the rectangles in an arbitrary order. After you have printed the answer, print the end of the line and perform "flush". Your program should terminate immediately after it print the answer.
To flush you can use (just after printing an integer and end-of-line):
See the documentation for other languages.
You will get the Wrong Answer verdict if you ask more than 200 queries, or if you print an incorrect coordinates.
You will get the Idleness Limit Exceeded verdict if you don't print anything (but you should) or if you forget about flushing the output (more info below).
The first line should contain an integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 216).
The second line should contain four integers x1, y1, x2, y2 (1 ≤ x1 ≤ x2 ≤ n, 1 ≤ y1 ≤ y2 ≤ n) — the description of the first rectangle.
The third line contains the description of the second rectangle in the similar way.

output.ai: 进行查询时，你需要输出 "? x1 y1 x2 y2"（不含引号）（1 ≤ x1 ≤ x2 ≤ n，1 ≤ y1 ≤ y2 ≤ n），其中（x1, y1）表示查询矩形左下角单元格的位置，（x2, y2）表示查询矩形右上角单元格的位置。你最多可以进行 200 次查询。每次查询后，你都应该执行 "flush" 操作并读取答案。
如果你认为已经确定了两个矩形的位置（或查询次数已用尽），则应输出 "! x11 y11 x12 y12 x21 y21 x22 y22"（不含引号），其中前四个整数描述第一个矩形的左下角和右上角单元格，后四个整数描述第二个矩形对应的单元格。你可以按任意顺序输出这两个矩形。输出答案后，输出行尾并执行 "flush"。输出答案后，你的程序应立即终止。

其他语言请参阅相关文档。
如果你进行超过 200 次查询，或者输出了错误的坐标，将会得到 Wrong Answer 判定。
如果你没有输出任何内容（但你应该输出），或者忘记刷新输出缓冲区（更多信息见下文），你将得到 Idleness Limit Exceeded 判定。
第一行应包含一个整数 n（2 ≤ n ≤ 2¹⁶）。
第二行应包含四个整数 x1、y1、x2、y2（1 ≤ x1 ≤ x2 ≤ n，1 ≤ y1 ≤ y2 ≤ n），表示第一个矩形。
第三行以类似的方式包含第二个矩形的描述。

legend.ai: Filya 刚刚学会了一种新的几何图形——矩形。现在给定一个由 n × n 个单位方格组成的网格。行从下到上编号为 1 到 n，列从左到右编号为 1 到 n。位于第 r 行和第 c 列交点处的方格记为 (r, c)。Filya 涂出了两个矩形，使得它们的边均与坐标轴平行，并且每个方格要么完全位于矩形内部，要么完全位于矩形外部。此外，没有任何方格同时位于两个矩形中。
后来，刺猬 Filya 对他的矩形所在的位置产生了兴趣，但他找不到涂有这些矩形的纸张了。纸张被 Sonya 拿走了，现在她想和 Filya 玩一个小游戏。他告诉她一个查询矩形，她需要回答完全位于该查询矩形内的初始矩形数量。查询矩形需要满足与初始矩形相同的条件。如果一个矩形的每个方格都位于查询矩形内，则称该矩形完全位于查询矩形内。
Filya 非常了解 Sonya，因此确信如果他提问超过 200 次，她就会停止回答。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含一个整数 n（2 ≤ n ≤ 2¹⁶），表示场地的大小。
对于每次查询，都会返回一个介于 0 和 2 之间的整数，表示完全位于查询矩形内的初始矩形数量。
